result.summary: The page is largely well-rendered. One visible defect: the restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' list is clipped mid-word ('Tokumaru Ramei'), despite ample empty space before the rating on the right. Other elements (header, search, chips, promo banner, carousel, bottom nav) appear intact.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' section is truncated mid-character (renders as 'Tokumaru Ramei') even though there is plenty of free horizontal space between the title and the rating '4.8 (500+)'. This is a hard clip with no ellipsis, indicating the title container has an incorrectly constrained width.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to use the available width (e.g., flex: 1 with the rating as a fixed-width sibling) and apply proper text overflow handling with an ellipsis for genuinely long names instead of hard clipping.
